title: John Mack moves away from a physical explanation of abductions

tellings.quote: he was he became less convinced that this was a purely physical nuts andbolts phenomenon

plain: The Harvard psychiatrist John Mack, who studied people who said they had been taken by aliens, became over the years "less convinced that this was a purely physical nuts and bolts phenomenon," according to the neuroscientist Andrew Gallimore. Gallimore, who studies the psychedelic drug DMT, tells Michels this alongside the work of Rick Strassman, a psychiatrist who gave DMT to volunteers. He raises it because it suggests abductions may happen in some realm of the mind rather than in physical spacecraft.
